question: चित्रवर्णने 'अस्मिन् चित्रे' इत्यस्य कः अर्थः? (What is the meaning of 'अस्मिन् चित्रे' in picture description?) 🖼️
explanation: Great! 'अस्मिन्' (in this) is the locative case (सप्तमी विभक्ति) of 'इदम्', and 'चित्रे' means 'in the picture'. It is the most common way to start a description. 🌟
hint: It tells us WHERE things are happening, indicating location.

question: यदि चित्रे एकः वृक्षः अस्ति, तर्हि क्रियापदं किम् भविष्यति? (If there is one tree in the picture, what will be the verb?) 🌳
explanation: Excellent! For a singular subject (एकवचन) like 'एकः वृक्षः', we use the singular verb 'अस्ति' (is). ✨
hint: Look for the verb used for a single object.

question: यदि चित्रे द्वौ बालकौ स्तः, तर्हि क्रियापदं किम्? (If there are two boys in the picture, what is the correct verb?) 👦👦
explanation: Awesome! 'स्तः' is the dual form (द्विवचन) of the root 'अस्' (to be). It perfectly matches 'द्वौ बालकौ'. 🌟
hint: Dual subject requires a dual verb.

question: यदि चित्रे बहवः जनाः सन्ति, तर्हि शुद्धं वाक्यं किम्? (If there are many people in the picture, what is the correct sentence?) 👥
explanation: Perfect! 'जनाः' is plural, so it must take the plural verb 'सन्ति'. Subject-verb agreement is key! 🎉
hint: Match the plural noun with the plural verb.

question: 'इदं चित्रम् कस्यापि वाटिकायाः ___।' अत्र रिक्तस्थाने किम् आगमिष्यति? (What will come in the blank?) 🏞️
explanation: Fantastic! The subject here is 'इदं चित्रम्' (This picture), which is singular, so it takes the singular verb 'अस्ति'. 🏆
hint: The subject is 'चित्रम्' (singular).

question: चित्रे पक्षिणः आकाशे किं कुर्वन्ति? (What do birds do in the sky in a picture?) 🐦
explanation: Wonderful! Birds (पक्षिणः/खगाः) fly in the sky, so the correct Sanskrit verb is 'उड्डयन्ते' or 'उत्पतन्ति'. 🌈
hint: Think about the natural action of birds in the sky.

question: 'चित्रे सुन्दराणि ___ विकसन्ति।' (Beautiful ___ bloom in the picture.) 🌸
explanation: Spot on! The verb 'विकसन्ति' means 'bloom', and it is flowers (पुष्पाणि) that bloom in a garden. 🌷
hint: What blooms beautifully in a garden?

question: चित्रे कन्दुकं दर्शयितुं कः शब्दः प्रयुज्यते? (Which word is used to show a ball in a picture?) ⚽
explanation: Great! 'कन्दुकम्' is the Sanskrit word for 'ball'. If kids are playing with a ball, they use 'कन्दुकेन' (with a ball). 🎾
hint: It is a round object used for playing.

question: यदि चित्रे सूर्योदयः भवति, तर्हि वाक्यं किम्? (If there is a sunrise in the picture, what is the sentence?) 🌅
explanation: Awesome! 'सूर्यः' means sun and 'उदेति' means rises. This is a very common sentence for morning scenery pictures! 🌄
hint: Look for the word meaning 'Sun'.

question: चित्रे वानराः वृक्षे किं कुर्वन्ति? (What do monkeys do on the tree in a picture?) 🐒
explanation: Excellent! Monkeys are known for jumping. In Sanskrit, the plural verb for jumping is 'कूर्दन्ति'. 🌴
hint: What is the most common action of a monkey?

question: मयूरः चित्रे किं करोति? (What does a peacock do in a picture?) 🦚
explanation: Perfect! A peacock (मयूरः) is famous for dancing, so we use the verb 'नृत्यति' (dances) in singular form. ☔
hint: Think of what a peacock does when it rains.

question: चित्रे जलं प्रवहति, तत् दर्शयितुं कः शब्दः प्रयुज्यते? (Water flows in the picture, which word shows this?) 💧
explanation: Fantastic! Flowing water usually represents a river ('नदी' in Sanskrit). You can write 'चित्रे नदी वहति' (A river flows in the picture). 🚣
hint: Which of these contains flowing water?

question: मीनाः जले किं कुर्वन्ति? (What do fishes do in the water?) 🐟
explanation: Wonderful! 'मीनाः' means fishes (plural), and 'तरन्ति' means swim. Fishes swim in the water! 🐠
hint: What is the action of fish in water?

question: 'उपरि' इत्यस्य कः अर्थः? (What is the meaning of 'उपरि' in location?) ⬆️
explanation: Spot on! 'उपरि' means above or on top. For example, 'वृक्षस्य उपरि खगाः सन्ति' (Birds are on top of the tree). 🌳
hint: It is the opposite of below.

question: वृक्षस्य ___ बालकः उपविशति। (The boy sits ___ the tree.) 🌳
explanation: Great! A boy usually sits 'under' or 'below' a tree for shade. 'अधः' means below. 🌿
hint: Where would someone sit to get shade from a tree?

question: शिक्षकः श्यामपट्टे किं करोति? (What does the teacher do on the blackboard?) 👨‍🏫
explanation: Awesome! A teacher (शिक्षकः) writes (लिखति) on the blackboard (श्यामपट्टे) to teach students. 🏫
hint: What action is done on a blackboard?

question: यदि बालकः पुस्तकं पठति, तर्हि संस्कृतवाक्यं किम्? (If a boy reads a book, what is the Sanskrit sentence?) 📖
options: बालकः पुस्तकं लिखति (Boy writes a book) ✍️
बालकः पुस्तकं पठति (Boy reads a book) 📘
बालकः पुस्तकं पश्यति (Boy sees a book) 👀
बालकः पुस्तकं नयति (Boy takes a book) 🎒
answer: बालकः पुस्तकं पठति (Boy reads a book) 📘
explanation: Excellent! 'बालकः' (boy) 'पुस्तकम्' (book) 'पठति' (reads) is the perfect grammatical sentence for this action. 🤓
hint: Match the verb for 'reads'.

question: छात्राः वेगेन किं कुर्वन्ति? (What do students do with speed/fast?) 🏃‍♂️
explanation: Perfect! 'वेगेन' means with speed/fast, and running (धावन्ति) is an action done with speed. 💨
hint: Which action requires speed?

question: 'उद्यानम्' इत्यस्य हिन्दी-अर्थः कः? (What is the Hindi meaning of 'उद्यानम्'?) 🏞️
explanation: Fantastic! 'उद्यानम्' or 'वाटिका' means a garden or park. It is a very common setting in picture description questions. 🌻
hint: It is a place full of trees and flowers.

question: यदि चित्रं विद्यालयस्य अस्ति, तर्हि प्रथमं वाक्यं किम् भवेत्? (If the picture is of a school, what should be the first sentence?) 🏫
options: इदं चित्रम् आपणस्य अस्ति (It is a shop) 🏪
इदं चित्रम् विद्यालयस्य अस्ति (It is a school) 🎒
इदं चित्रम् नदीतीरस्य अस्ति (It is a riverbank) 🌊
इदं चित्रम् गृहस्य अस्ति (It is a house) 🏡
answer: इदं चित्रम् विद्यालयस्य अस्ति (It is a school) 🎒
explanation: Wonderful! Stating the subject of the picture is the best way to start. 'विद्यालयस्य' means 'of a school'. 🎓
hint: Look for the Sanskrit word for school.

question: 'ग्रामस्य' इत्यत्र का विभक्तिः अस्ति, या चित्रवर्णने प्रयुज्यते? (Which case is in 'ग्रामस्य', used in picture description?) 🏡
explanation: Great! 'ग्रामस्य' means 'of the village'. The 'स्य' ending usually denotes the Genitive case (षष्ठी विभक्ति - relationship/possession). 🛖
hint: It translates to 'of the village' (का, के, की).

question: 'चित्रे' इति पदे का विभक्तिः? (Which case is in the word 'चित्रे'?) 🖼️
explanation: Awesome! 'चित्रे' means 'in the picture'. Location words (in, on, at) use the Locative case (सप्तमी विभक्ति). 📌
hint: It means 'IN the picture' (में, पर).

question: यदि चित्रम् अतीव सुन्दरम् अस्ति, तर्हि किं कथयामः? (If the picture is very beautiful, what do we say?) 😍
explanation: Spot on! To conclude a picture description nicely, you can write 'इदं चित्रम् मनोहरम् अस्ति' (This picture is beautiful/attractive). ✨
hint: Look for the words 'सुन्दरम्' or 'मनोहरम्'.

question: कुक्कुराः चित्रे किं कुर्वन्ति? (What do dogs do in the picture?) 🐕
explanation: Excellent! The natural action for dogs (कुक्कुराः) is barking, which translates to 'बुक्कन्ति' in Sanskrit. 🐾
hint: What sound do dogs make?

question: धेनवः (गावः) क्षेत्रे किं कुर्वन्ति? (What do cows do in the field?) 🐄
explanation: Perfect! Cows (धेनवः or गावः) eat grass in the field, which is called grazing ('चरन्ति' in Sanskrit). 🌾
hint: What do cows do with grass?

question: नद्यां का अस्ति? (What is in the river?) ⛵
explanation: Fantastic! A boat ('नौका') floats in the river ('नद्यां'). This is a common element in nature pictures. 🌊
hint: It is used to travel across water.

question: यदि चित्रे पर्वताः सन्ति, तर्हि कः शब्दः बहुवचने अस्ति? (If there are mountains in the picture, which word is in plural?) ⛰️
explanation: Wonderful! 'पर्वतः' is singular, and 'पर्वताः' is the nominative plural, meaning 'many mountains'. 🌄
hint: Look for the word ending with 'आः' like 'बालकाः'.

question: आकाशे के गर्जन्ति? (Who thunders in the sky?) ☁️
explanation: Great! Clouds ('मेघाः') gather in the sky and thunder ('गर्जन्ति') during the rainy season. 🌧️
hint: What causes rain and thunder?

question: चित्रे वर्षा भवति। अत्र 'वर्षा' कः शब्दः? (It is raining in the picture. What is the word 'वर्षा' here?) 🌧️
explanation: Awesome! 'वर्षा' means rain. 'वर्षा भवति' is a simple and correct sentence to describe a rainy scene. 💧
hint: It brings water from the sky.

question: कृषकः क्षेत्रे किं करोति? (What does a farmer do in the field?) 🚜
explanation: Spot on! A farmer ('कृषकः') works in the field and ploughs ('कर्षति') the land to grow crops. 🚜
hint: What is the primary job of a farmer in the field?

question: 'अत्र' इत्यस्य अर्थः कः? (What is the meaning of 'अत्र'?) 📍
explanation: Excellent! 'अत्र' is an indeclinable (अव्यय) meaning 'Here'. It's very useful for pointing out things in a picture (e.g., अत्र एकः वृक्षः अस्ति). 👇
hint: It means the opposite of 'There'.

question: 'तत्र' इत्यस्य अर्थः कः? (What is the meaning of 'तत्र'?) 🗺️
explanation: Perfect! 'तत्र' means 'There'. You can use it to describe objects in the background of the picture (e.g., तत्र पर्वताः सन्ति). 👉
hint: It means the opposite of 'Here'.

question: 'सर्वत्र' इत्यस्य अर्थः कः? (What is the meaning of 'सर्वत्र'?) 🌍
explanation: Fantastic! 'सर्वत्र' means 'Everywhere'. E.g., 'चित्रे सर्वत्र हरियाली (हरितमा) अस्ति' (There is greenery everywhere in the picture). 🌿
hint: It means in all places.

question: वृद्धः मार्गे किं करोति? (What does the old man do on the road?) 🚶‍♂️
explanation: Wonderful! An old man ('वृद्धः') typically walks slowly, so 'चलति' (walks) is the most appropriate verb. 👴
hint: What action is done using a walking stick?

question: 'बालिकाः' चित्रे किं कुर्वन्ति? (What do 'बालिकाः' (girls) do in the picture?) 👧👧
explanation: Great! 'बालिकाः' is plural, so it must be matched with the plural verb 'क्रीडन्ति' (They play). 👭
hint: Match the plural noun with a plural verb.

question: 'समीपे' इत्यस्य अर्थः कः? (What is the meaning of 'समीपे'?) 🏘️
explanation: Awesome! 'समीपे' means near or close to. Example: 'वृक्षस्य समीपे बालकः अस्ति' (The boy is near the tree). 🎯
hint: It is the opposite of 'Far'.

question: रात्रौ आकाशे कः प्रकाशते? (Who shines in the sky at night?) 🌙
explanation: Spot on! In a night scene picture, the moon ('चन्द्रः') shines ('प्रकाशते') in the sky. 🌌
hint: It is the bright object visible at night.

question: रात्रौ आकाशे काः भान्ति? (What shines in the sky at night - plural?) ✨
explanation: Excellent! Stars ('तारकाः') shine in the night sky. The verb 'भान्ति' or 'प्रकाशन्ते' can be used. 🌃
hint: They are many tiny twinkling lights in the sky.

question: बालकाः 'फुटबॉल' इति केन क्रीडन्ति? (With what do boys play 'football' in Sanskrit?) ⚽
explanation: Perfect! 'पाद' means foot and 'कन्दुकम्' means ball. By combining them in the instrumental case, we get 'पादकन्दुकेन' (with a football). 🥅
hint: Translate 'foot' + 'ball'.

question: महिलाः चुल्ल्यां किं कुर्वन्ति? (What do women do on the stove?) 🍳
explanation: Fantastic! 'पचन्ति' means they cook. In a kitchen scene, women ('महिलाः') cook food. 🥘
hint: What action is done on a stove?

question: 'वृक्षाः ___।' अत्र उचितं क्रियापदं किम्? (What is the correct verb here?) 🌳🌳
explanation: Wonderful! 'वृक्षाः' is plural, meaning many trees. Therefore, it takes the plural verb 'सन्ति'. 🏞️
hint: The subject is plural, so the verb must be plural.

question: वृक्षात् कानि पतन्ति? (What fall from the tree?) 🍂
explanation: Great! Leaves ('पत्राणि') or fruits ('फलानि') fall from a tree. This is useful for describing an autumn scene. 🍃
hint: They are green or dry and grow on branches.

question: 'चित्रम्' इत्यस्य विशेषणं किम् भवितुम् अर्हति? (What can be an adjective for 'चित्रम्'?) 🖼️
explanation: Awesome! 'चित्रम्' is a neuter gender (नपुंसकलिंग) word, so its adjective must also be neuter: 'सुन्दरम्'. ✨
hint: Match the gender of the noun 'चित्रम्'.

question: चित्रे ___ जनाः सन्ति। (There are ___ people in the picture.) 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦
explanation: Spot on! 'जनाः' is plural masculine. 'अनेके' (many) correctly matches its gender and number! 👪
hint: The noun 'जनाः' is plural masculine.

question: मार्गे ___ गच्छति। (The ___ goes on the road.) 🚗
explanation: Excellent! On a road ('मार्गे'), a vehicle or car ('यानम्') travels. 🛣️
hint: What travels on a road?

question: चित्रे ___ बालकौ स्तः। (There are ___ boys in the picture.) 👦👦
explanation: Perfect! 'बालकौ' is masculine dual, so the number must be 'द्वौ' (Two for masculine). 👦👦
hint: Match the gender (masculine) for the number two.

question: चित्रे ___ बालिके स्तः। (There are ___ girls in the picture.) 👧👧
explanation: Fantastic! 'बालिके' is feminine dual, so the number must be 'द्वे' (Two for feminine). 👯‍♀️
hint: Match the gender (feminine) for the number two.

question: चित्रवर्णनस्य अन्ते प्रायः वयं किं लिखामः? (What do we usually write at the end of a picture description?) 📝
options: अतः इदं चित्रं सुन्दरम् अस्ति (Thus, this picture is beautiful) 🌟
तत्र एकः वृक्षः अस्ति (There is a tree) 🌳
answer: अतः इदं चित्रं सुन्दरम् अस्ति (Thus, this picture is beautiful) 🌟
explanation: Wonderful! Ending the description with a positive concluding statement like 'इदं चित्रम् सुन्दरम् अस्ति' makes the paragraph complete and impressive. 🏆
hint: Look for a concluding sentence.

question: 'खगाः' इत्यस्य पर्यायपदं किम्? (What is the synonym of 'खगाः'?) 🦅
explanation: Great! 'खगाः' and 'पक्षिणः' both mean birds. Using synonyms makes your picture description richer! 🦜
hint: It means creatures that fly in the sky.

question: 'बालकः पश्यति' इत्यस्य बहुवचनं किम्? (What is the plural of 'बालकः पश्यति'?) 👀
explanation: Awesome! 'बालकः' changes to 'बालकाः' and 'पश्यति' changes to 'पश्यन्ति' in plural form. Grammar precision is important in Chitravarnanam! 🎯
hint: Make both the noun and the verb plural.
